title: Rewinding the input head
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose a mode bit and an input word $x$, and let $c$ be a configuration of the corresponding loop host on $x$. If $c$ is in control phase $4$, then after some $t\leq c$'s input-head position plus $2$ steps, the host is in the startup body-call state with the body in its initial state and its input head at position $1$; all other configuration data are unchanged.
